versions.changelog:
- Initial metadata file (_meta.json) added for the skill.
- Documentation and code examples updated to use relative script paths (e.g., python scripts/fetch_pdf.py), improving portability and clarity.

Initial release — enables structured, Chinese-language reading notes from PDFs, arXiv, or titles.

- New scripts to fetch PDFs by local path, arXiv URL, or paper title, and to extract text from PDFs.
- Standardized note template and output structure in Chinese, preserving English technical terms.
- Automatic workflow for searching, downloading, extracting, and summarizing papers.
- Old reference files (output-cn.md, venue-tiers.md) removed; new reference and template files added.
